ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1: Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is amended by changing all the M1-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2-L in the area bounded by:

The alley next north of and parallel to West Flournoy Street;

the alley next west of and parallel to South Cicero Avenue;

West Flournoy Street; and

a line 255.1 feet west of and parallel to South Cicero Avenue

to those of M3-2 Heavy Industry District, which is hereby established in the area above
described.

SECTION 2: This ordinance shall take effect upon its passage and due publication.

Common Address(es): 4814-4822 W. Flournoy St.

3630.0001
